rationale: Pivot from xgb_meta_label (14 sweep iters #619-#632 plateaued: best 5/7 #631 +18.6%, mean wp ~3.4, no monotone improvement) to the new MC-dropout trainer. Default conf_lambda=0.5 / drop_rate=0.20 was too aggressive — score compression dropped 5/7 windows to thr=0 fallback — but the mechanism IS proven: W2 (thr=0.6, n=24, WR=41.7%) and W3 (thr=0.5, n=24, WR=45.8%) cleanly cleared the gate with selective behavior. Train-mode sweep should explore lower conf_lambda (0.0–0.3) × lower drop_rate (0.05–0.15) to lift mean predictions above the 0.30 floor while keeping enough std-spread to gate fragile rows — the goal HP combo should produce thr≥0.3 selections in W4/W5/W6/W7.
